subject.title: Bug: Gateway falsely marks healthy local vLLM endpoints as timed out/overloaded, causing 1–23 min fallback cascades

question: Should this issue wait for a maintainer-run current-main local vLLM reproduction before any new ClawSweeper fix PR is queued?
rationale: Source and related PRs prove several slices were fixed, but they do not prove the original healthy-vLLM false-timeout and gateway RPC cascade is still reproducible or identify which owner boundary should change next.

options.title: Run live reproduction first
options.body: Capture current-main local vLLM and gateway timing evidence before choosing the timeout, fallback, auth-profile, cron/live-session, or RPC repair path.

options.title: Queue a narrow fix now
options.body: Allow a repair attempt against the most likely timeout/fallback path, accepting higher risk that it changes the wrong behavior without live proof.

options.title: Close as partially fixed
options.body: Treat the remaining symptoms as obsolete despite missing current-main live proof, which would risk losing a still-valid availability bug.

recommendation.title: Run live reproduction first
recommendation.body: Capture current-main local vLLM and gateway timing evidence before choosing the timeout, fallback, auth-profile, cron/live-session, or RPC repair path.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz is the current assignee and merged the adjacent cron fallback fix, making them the best available owner for proof sufficiency and next-boundary triage.
